skillset.skill: 8s CT - 2000% Light DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 30. If self is unafflicted by Status Ailments, increase Arts by 50 instead.
skillset.arts: 18000% Light DMG (PHY). For 10s, increase Allies' stats by 30% and reduce Enemies' PHY RES by 20%.
skillset.truearts:
67000% Light DMG (PHY). Sacrifice 10% of own MAX HP. For 15s, increase Allies' Arts by 6/s. An additional effect occurs depending on the Sword Mode Emperor Isliid is in when True Arts is activated.
Note: This unit's Arts Gen is Type B and will not stack with other Type B Arts Gen.

passive.ability1: When in Skylight Mode (1st Position), True Arts increase Allies' accuracy by 30% for 15s and True Arts' DMG against Gods by 150%.
passive.ability2: When in Terra Master Mode (2nd Position), True Arts increase Allies' DMG RES by 20% for 15s and True Arts' DMG against Humans by 150%.
passive.ability3: When in Darkbringer Mode (3rd Position), True Arts increase Allies' ATK by 50% for 15s and True Arts' DMG against Demons by 150%.
passive.ability4: Note: When set as the 4th Position, modes cycle every Arts (Skylight -> Terra Master -> Darkbringer -> repeat).

true1.name: Sky Light
true1.skill: 45s CT - 10000% Light DMG (MAG). For 10s, reduce Enemies' Light RES by 30%. If user is Light, increase own DMG by 50%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Emporer of Isliid, Increase accuracy by 30%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.

true2.name: Terra Master
true2.skill: 35s CT - 5000% Light DMG (PHY). For 10s, increase Allies' Arts by 3/s, and increase Human Allies' DMG by 35%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Emperor Isliid, Increase stats by 30%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: Increase DMG by 20% to Enemies in BREAK.

true3.name: Dark Bringer
true3.skill: 55s CT - 13000% Light DMG (PHY). For 10s, reduce Enemies' PHY RES by 40%. If user is Light, increase own ATK by 40%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Emperor Isliid, increase DMG by 30%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
